brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights condemned Israel's systematic targeting and assassination of police and internal security personnel in Gaza, the PCHR reported. The campaign includes attacks on officers while they perform duties at police stations and security checkpoints across the territory.

PCHR characterized the operations as creating chaos and rendering conditions uninhabitable in Gaza. The organization said the targeting of security and police officials amounts to a systematic campaign by Israeli Occupation Forces.
dek: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) condemns in the strongest terms the systematic targeting and assassination campaign carried out by the Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) against police and internal security personnel and officials in the Gaza Strip, including attacks targeting them while on duty at police stations and security checkpoints.
title: Israeli forces target Gaza police and security personnel systematically
